data.post_summary: Key Maker & Locksmith opened on 1 October 2026 on Gollahalli Main Road, Siraj Layout, Electronic City Phase 1, Bengaluru. We provide key duplication, keys for compatible cars and bikes, lock repair and replacement, and lockout assistance. The shop is open 24 hours, with on-site service across our listed areas. Visit us or contact us to confirm your key or lock requirements and a quote.

Save 10% on eligible standard house-key duplication at our Electronic City Phase 1 shop, with a maximum discount of ₹100 per order. Bring a compatible original key and show this Google offer or mention SPARE10 before placing your order.

Sticking key or faulty door lock?

If your key is difficult to turn, avoid forcing it. We assess compatible door locks, cylinders, handles and bolts, and offer repair, replacement and installation for homes, offices and shops.

Shop visits and on-site service are available around Electronic City and our listed areas. We are open 24 hours. Contact us with the lock details and location to confirm suitable parts, availability and the quote, including any travel or installation charges.

Car remote shell or a new key? A cracked casing may need a replacement shell. We replace compatible car remote bodies and make or program keys and fobs for supported vehicles. Share the make, model, year and issue so we can confirm compatibility and a quote. Visit our shop on Gollahalli Main Road, Electronic City Phase 1.

Frequently asked questions

Where are you?
Gollahalli Main Road, Siraj Layout, Electronic City Phase 1, Bengaluru 560100.

Are you open at night?
Yes. We are available 24 hours, seven days a week.

Do you visit customers?
Yes. On-site service is available across our 20 listed areas, including locations 10 km or more away. Confirm availability and travel charges for your address.

Which keys do you make?
Supported home, office, shop and cupboard keys, plus keys for compatible cars and bikes. Bring the original key if available.

Do you program car keys and fobs?
Yes, for compatible models. Share the vehicle make, model, year and existing key details.

Can you help with lockouts?
Yes, for authorised owners and occupants. We also repair and replace compatible locks.

How much does it cost?
The quote depends on the key or lock, vehicle, parts, programming, travel and installation. Contact us with the job details before work begins.

Which payments do you accept?
Cash, UPI, IMPS and NEFT. Cards are not currently accepted.
